V.''', commonly known as '''Schalke 04''' ({{IPA|de|ˌʃalkə nʊl ˈfiːɐ̯|lang|De-Schalke 04.ogg}}) and abbreviated as '''S04''' ({{IPA|de|ˈɛs nʊl fiːɐ̯|lang|De-S04.ogg}}), is a [[Professionalism in association football|professional]] [[sports club]] from the [[Gelsenkirchen-Schalke|Schalke]] district of [[Gelsenkirchen]], North Rhine-Westphalia. It is best known for its [[Association football|football]] team, which plays in the [[Bundesliga]], the top flight of the [[German football league system]], following [[Promotion and relegation|promotion]] from the [[2. Bundesliga]] in [[2025–26 2. Bundesliga|2025–26]]. Other activities offered by the club include [[sport of athletics|athletics]], [[basketball]], [[team handball|handball]], [[table tennis]], [[winter sport]]s and [[eSports]]. The "04" in the club's name derives from its formation in 1904. Schalke have been one of the most popular professional [[football team]]s in Germany, even though the club's heyday was in the 1930s and 1940s. As of September 2025, the club has 210,000 members,{{Cite web |date=13 September 2025 |title=Als dritter deutscher Klub: Schalke begrüßt 210.000. Mitglied |url=https://www.ruhr24.de/s04/fc-schalke-04-mitglieder-zahl-aktuell-bvb-fc-bayern-vergleich-matthias-tillmann-gelsenkirchen-s04-94157723.html |access-date=19 February 2026 |website=www.ruhr24.de |language=de}} making it the third-largest football club in Germany and the [[List of sports clubs by membership|sixth-largest club in the world]] in terms of membership.{{Cite web|url=https://de.statista.com/statistik/daten/studie/3828/umfrage/die-beliebtesten-fussballclubs-weltweit/|title=Fußballclubs weltweit – Anzahl der Mitglieder 2021|access-date=22 December 2021|archive-date=22 December 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211222104513/https://de.statista.com/statistik/daten/studie/3828/umfrage/die-beliebtesten-fussballclubs-weltweit/|url-status=live}} Schalke have won seven [[List of German football champions|German championships]], five [[DFB-Pokal]]s, one [[DFB Ligapokal]], one [[DFL-Supercup]], one [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]] and two [[UEFA Intertoto Cup]]s. In 1937, Schalke became the first German club to win [[Double (association football)|the double]]. Since 2001, Schalke's stadium has been the [[Arena AufSchalke|Veltins-Arena]]. Schalke hold a long-standing rivalry with [[Ruhr]] neighbors [[Borussia Dortmund]], known as the [[Revierderby]]."}}
